answer: The kernel assignment is published and pearl records each panel. Shards are assigned from the ember graph, and hence cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so someone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 612 impostors cost 1008 times the honest price and take 14 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
